chapter: Prison work songs and Lead Belly
title: Prison work songs, lead singers and the nickname Guitar
summary: Welch explains singing while chopping and raking, who leads the row, and being called Guitar.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, what kind of... What kind of stuff was this y'all did when y'all sang? The work songs, you know?
Uh, well, uh, at that time, way back in... Mm-hmm. On our jobs. Mm-hmm. We'd get a good song, and we'd all get together and play. I mean, work and sing.
Mm-hmm.
Well, we'd keep time with our song. We'd be playing. I mean, we'd be playing, uh... We'd be working and keeping time with our work, you know?
Do you sing like... What kind of work would that be?
Well, that'd be chopping with axe or either chopping... Yeah. ...or raking headland back with a hole.
Mm-hmm.
So we'd be going along chopping ditch banks with holes.
Digging with a shovel? Do you ever sing?
No, sir. We don't sing with the shovel. We don't have time to sing with the shovel. We need all that wind and shovel with it.
Now, what about, uh... Lead belly? Did he ever do any of that type of work with his gang, you know?

Well, yes, sir. He did. Before, uh... He... He... He got on the yard. Well, he went to the doctor several times. The doctor found out he wasn't able to work. They just put him on the yard and told him to take the other yard.
Well, what do you call, uh... The main guy that's... That's leading the row, what do you call him? What's his name?
Well, uh... Just anybody could lead the row. If he could sing, it's all right. Doesn't matter who it was.
No... No name. I mean, you wouldn't call him a lead row?
No, sir.
Lead row man?
No, sir. Just like this, uh... So they got all different names. Some of them called shotguns. Some called pistol. Some called ratty red. Some called...
Mm-hmm.
Nose.
Yeah.
One gone. Guitar also. That's what they called me. Guitar.
Mm-hmm.
So... It's whatever come into your mind that they call you. That's it.
